title: Podman push rate factor 1000(?) too high
body:
### Issue Description

podman version 5.8.6

I’m pushing a big image over a slow line. This last chunk has a slowly growing first number, while the last number oscillates between 800 MiB/s and this:
```
Copying blob 859122f6c3ca [=====================>----------------] 1.4GiB / 2.4GiB | 1.2 GiB/s
```
At that rate it should be done in about one second. 🦖 

The receiving repo is on Artifactory Enterprise Plus 7.161.15 rev 861 (at least the GUI is.)

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. podman push big-image

### Describe the results you received

Vastly wrong (maybe factor 1000 or 1024 too high) transfer rate

### Describe the results you expected

A plausible rate
